name: The Universe
overview: Scripture reveals that the universe is the intentional creation of God, who made the heavens and the earth at the beginning (Genesis 1:1) and formed them not in vain but to be inhabited (Isaiah 45:18). Christ, as the radiant image of God, sustains all things by His powerful word and, having accomplished redemption, reigns exalted (Hebrews 1:3). Ultimately, all creation exists for God's pleasure and glory, affirming His worthiness as Creator (Revelation 4:11).
